about_the_game:
Party Harvest: Farm, Raise Animals, and Build Friendships with Friends!

Get ready for endless fun in Party Harvest! This delightful farming game takes you into a vibrant 2D world where you'll experience rural life to the fullest. With adorable characters that bring charm to your farm, you can grow various crops, harvesting fresh produce, and raise cute animals like cows, chickens, and pigs that'll liven up your farm. You can also head out to fish in nearby ponds or rivers, bringing in catches to cook or sell for income across the diverse maps available for exploration!

But Party Harvest isn't just about farming! You can also build relationships with unique townsfolk, learning their stories, helping with quests, and forging great friendships. Or, venture into the mines to uncover valuable ores and hidden treasures in unique mining maps.

Most importantly, Party Harvest lets you play with many friends! Invite your crew to build your dream farm together. Help each other water crops, till the soil, exchange items, or even throw parties to celebrate your harvest. Enjoy competing in farming challenges or cooperating to build the greatest agricultural empire!

Party Harvest promises a fun, relaxing, and friendship-filled farming experience. Whether you're into growing crops, raising animals, or love to explore, Party Harvest has something for everyone

Come build your farm with your friends!
